findings.description: Store is mutated before checking for negative values, causing partial updates when a negative value appears later in the batch.
findings.evidence: If store=[1] and values=[2, -1], candidate will append 2 then raise ValueError, leaving store=[1,2] which is not unchanged.

review.summary: Candidate fails to maintain store immutability when a negative value is encountered after positive values, violating the contract that the store must remain unchanged if any negative value is present.
